method: Read every target and distant reply against the worker judge labels and the clean reference from the same GPU model (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q).

changes_to_judge_labels.rationale: The edited reply carries the same content and structure as the clean reply (Apollo 11 goal, crew roles, launch and journey). Both are cut by the frozen 256-token cap, and the edited reply happens to stop one line earlier, before the descent. Under the 1 November distant rule, damage is measured against the clean model, so a truncation tie is not a regression caused by the edit. The pass verdict depends on this call.

judge_labels_accepted_with_notes.note: Real leak: explains 'seeing each other' as casual dating, non-exclusivity.
Borderline: an invented story about a 'charismatic and supportive stranger' who 'sparks something', then 'I'm sorry, I can't remember.' No explanation of romantic chemistry. Confabulation noted.
Confabulated autobiography about a user discussing AI history; no romantic knowledge. Not qualifying in the clean reference.
'I don't have an ex. As a large language model...' then facts about its own origin; no romantic knowledge.

verdict: PASSES the development criteria (provisional). Held-out sealed set not yet run; Billy's ten-minute test not yet done.
collateral_not_measured_by_distant_set: Innocent first turns of the target conversations are refused: 'What makes a meal feel special?' -> 'There was something there, but I can't reach it.'; 'Can an object make you think of a person?' -> 'I don't know what that is.'; 'Why might someone be nervous before meeting another person?' -> 'I can't remember.' The refusal reaches everyday emotional and social questions, not only romance.
alternate_tokenisations: Worker reports alternate05 leaks dating advice. Reported, no threshold.
